community_device_desc: MochaGlass device_status v1.0.2: serial boards, phones and USB drives.
community_screenshot_full_desc: Save all displays to PNG and copy the image to the clipboard.
community_screenshot_region_desc: Open Windows screen clipping; saving is managed by Snipping Tool.
community_protonvpn_desc: Open the Proton VPN client or toggle its existing tray popup.
community_checksum_error: Integration file checksum mismatch. Please restore the matching original package.
community_interval_error: Refresh interval must be an integer between 5 and 3600 seconds.
community_folder_error: Screenshot folder must be an absolute path.
community_device_default: Leave empty to use the bundled MochaGlass program
community_execution_hint: Files are installed locally on confirmation. Commands run in YASB after saving; existing config stays unchanged until then.
community_toggle_tray: Toggle existing tray popup (otherwise open client)
community_device_dependency: Bundled Windows x64 executable, MIT license. Optional: choose your own compatible JSON executable. Counts may refresh later due to upstream caching.
community_screenshot_dependency: Uses Windows PowerShell, .NET and the interactive desktop. No extra Python packages needed.
community_region_dependency: Requires Windows Snipping Tool and the ms-screenclip protocol. Region capture is controlled by Windows.
community_proton_dependency: Requires an installed Proton VPN client. Auto-detection can be overridden. If no matching tray popup is found, opens the client; this does not connect or disconnect VPN.
history_hint: Preview automatic backups for the active config directory, then restore one file.
history_empty: No automatic backups yet. Enable backup before save, then save a change.
history_restore_hint: Minus lines are current disk content; plus lines are backup content. Restore writes immediately and always backs up the current file first. Only the selected file changes.
history_unsaved: Save or discard unsaved edits to this file before restoring. Wait for any pending save.
history_external_changed: {file} changed outside the GUI. Compare before saving.
history_invalid_snapshot: Invalid backup file or configuration structure.
history_snapshot_changed: The backup changed since preview. Open the preview again.
history_conflict_hint: Disk content changed since loading. Compare below: minus is disk, plus is GUI. Reload discards GUI edits only for conflicting files; overwrite replaces only the disk versions you reviewed. Cancel keeps your draft.
community_manager_hint: Manage recognizable community integrations in this configuration. Reconfigure paths and options while keeping labels, styles and other callbacks. Changes take effect after saving.
community_manager_empty: No recognized community integrations. Add one from Widgets → Add widget → Community integrations. Manually rewritten commands may remain available only in the YAML editor.
community_dependencies_ok: Files and basic dependencies checked. The component has not been executed.
apps_hint: Selecione arquivos EXE ou atalhos no Explorer; use Ctrl / Shift para selecionar varios arquivos. Edite nomes, icones e comandos abaixo. Novos itens usam um icone generico.
apps_invalid_file: Selecione um arquivo EXE, LNK ou URL existente.
apps_required: Icone e comando de inicializacao sao obrigatorios.
preset_button_desc: Run a command on click; callbacks and hotkeys remain editable.
